question: Does the run-1 DPO adapter beat its own null baseline on the frozen 31-task ruler?
why_now: The 2026-07-28 evaluation of this same adapter used the OLD 10-task bank, which was saturated (pass@3 = 0.9 on all 10 runs, both arms). The adapter was never scored on an instrument that could resolve a difference.

metric.rationale: The 20/80 greedy blend is not Chen et al. unbiased pass@k; it is bias at a changed estimand, not variance reduction.

design.test: Welch t-test on run-level pass@1, two-sided, alpha=0.05, never pooling the two arms sd
design.stopping_rule: FIXED N. No peeking, no early stop on effect. Re-size on variance only.

what_this_CANNOT_show: Anything general about DPO. One checkpoint has ZERO training-seed variance by construction, so se_diff has no slot for it (Dodge et al. 2020, Bouthillier et al. 2021). A positive result here is a look, not a verdict, and the real arm is 2-3 seeds.
Transfer beyond this task distribution. The ruler is 31 AceCode oss tasks; the training pool is a disjoint 43 tids from the same source.
That the ruler is unsaturated for THIS pair of arms. 27 channels are clearly live and 4 are weak; that was measured on the base model, not on these two.
